# Incoming fixtures

`hybrid.pdf` is project-authored fictional test data, generated by `generate.py` with reportlab/pypdf. It embeds the existing fictional UBL golden as `xrechnung.xml`. It verifies extraction, **not** PDF/A-3 or ZUGFeRD conformity. The rendered page was visually inspected.

`kosit-cii.xml` is the unmodified official KoSIT `01.01a-INVOICE_uncefact.xml`, retrieved 7 October 2026 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itplr-kosit/xrechnung-testsuite/master/src/test/business-cases/standard/01.01a-INVOICE_uncefact.xml . SHA-256: `727b51982a84c9b406599a7384783570910440ed405c9bb6d918b22442636886`. Upstream Apache-2.0 license is retained in `LICENSE-kosit`. The committed bytes, not a live moving branch, are used by tests. Its CII content passes the repository's pinned official KoSIT validator bundle.
